source: CARDI Farmer Notes (ព្រឹត្តិបត្រព័ត៌មានកសិកម), various issues, Cambodian Agricultural Research and Development Institute
text:
KA15 (ខា១៥): short-duration, photoperiod-insensitive variety releasable in any season, matures 95-105 days after sowing, height about 100cm, 8-10 tillers per hill, yields 4.0-7.4 tons/ha, moderately tolerant to rat damage, produces long slender aromatic grain (about 21.6% amylose).

Phka Romdoul (ផ្កា រំដួល): medium-duration, photoperiod-sensitive, flowers only around Oct 10-25 regardless of sowing date, height 110-170cm, yields 3.5-5.5 tons/ha, tolerates flooding well but is not tolerant of brown planthopper; this is Cambodia's premium export aromatic variety with high market value.

KA4 (ខា៤): long/heavy-duration, photoperiod-sensitive, flowers around Nov 8-15, height 132-173cm, yields 2.5-5.0 tons/ha, tolerates drought reasonably well but is not strongly tolerant of brown planthopper.

KA14 (ខា១៤): short-duration, photoperiod-insensitive, matures 95-105 days, height about 90cm, average 12 tillers/hill, yields 4.2-7.5 tons/ha, moderately tolerant to rice blast disease (ជំងឺបាល).

IR66 (អុីអែរ៦៦): short-duration, photoperiod-insensitive, matures 105-115 days, height 80-118cm, yields 4.0-6.5 tons/ha, not tolerant of brown planthopper; a widely-grown high-yield workhorse variety.

Sen Kraob 01 (សែនក្រអូប០១): short-duration, photoperiod-insensitive, matures 110-115 days, height 107-114cm, yields 3.9-4.9 tons/ha, resistant to stem borer and sheath blight; an aromatic variety with premium grain value.

When recommending a variety, match it to the farmer's actual planting season, water situation, and known local pest pressure rather than assuming higher yield alone makes one variety better than another.
